sql:
WITH RECURSIVE 
top_level AS (
    SELECT id, name FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
hierarchy AS (
    SELECT tl.id AS root_id, tl.name AS root_name, tl.id AS current_id, tl.id AS ancestor_id, 1::INTEGER AS level, 1.0::DOUBLE AS multiplier
    FROM top_level tl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT h.root_id, h.root_name, pr.contains_id AS current_id, h.ancestor_id, (h.level + 1)::INTEGER, (h.multiplier * pr.qty)::DOUBLE
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
),
item_quantities AS (
    SELECT current_id AS item_id, SUM(multiplier) AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    GROUP BY current_id
)
SELECT h.root_name AS container_name, p.name AS item_name, iq.total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p ON p.id = h.current_id
JOIN item_quantities iq ON iq.item_id = h.current_id
ORDER BY container_name, item_name, total_qty DESC
